AKAIYAI 256V 100Ah 26kWh C-ESSAKY25K-H High Voltage LiFePO4 Battery – Overview

Featuring a modular 5.22kWh pack design (5 packs total), it offers a reliable 26kWh rated energy capacity and a long lifespan of ≥6,000 cycles at 90% Depth of Discharge (DOD). With integrated smart BMS protection, RS485/CAN communication for wide inverter compatibility, and a flexible design expandable from 20.8kWh to 52kWh, this battery delivers safe, scalable, and efficient power storage for demanding commercial installations.

AKAIYAI RackMaster Pro A51R100-B – 5.12kWh Modular Lithium Battery for Solar & ESS Systems

AKAIYAI RackMaster Pro A51R100-B is a 51.2 V, 100 Ah rack-style lithium module delivering 5.12 kWh per unit for residential and light-commercial energy storage systems (ESS). As part of KAIYA’s RackMaster Pro line, this battery focuses on high cycle life, easy integration with hybrid inverters, and quick, low-maintenance installation in standard equipment racks.

With 6000+ cycles and excellent round-trip efficiency, the RackMaster Pro helps lower the lifetime cost of storage while keeping more of your solar energy usable. Its robust metal enclosure (IP20), quiet natural-convection cooling, and BMS (16S100A) protections make it a dependable core for solar self-consumption, backup power, and time-of-use optimization.

Integration is straightforward. The battery supports CAN, RS485, and RS232, enabling closed-loop operation with many popular hybrid inverters for accurate SOC reporting, safe charge limits, and optimized performance. Recommended charge is 20 A (max 50 A), with a CC 0.5C 56.8 V / CV 58.4 V profile, while discharge supports 100 A continuous (50 A recommended) with a 44.8 V cut-off. These settings, combined with precise control from compatible inverters, help protect cell health and sustain capacity over time.

The RackMaster Pro is built for practical installs. At 420×440×132 mm and ≈43.5 kg, it fits neatly in rack/cabinet spaces, uses M5 terminals for secure connections, and requires minimal service. Thanks to low self-discharge (<3%/month), systems stay ready even after extended standby periods. Charge in environments from -10 °C to +55 °C and discharge from -20 °C to +55 °C; store between 0 °C and +30 °C in a clean, dry area.

Scalability is simple. Start with one 5.12 kWh module and parallel up to 16 units to reach ≈40 kWh, expanding as loads grow—without redesigning your system. This flexibility suits homes and SMEs alike: keep essential loads (lighting, Wi-Fi, refrigeration, POS) online during outages; shift energy from off-peak to on-peak periods; and capture more daytime PV to use at night.

Use cases

  • Self-consumption of solar energy with evening/night usage

  • Backup power for essential loads during grid outages

  • Time-of-use shifting to reduce bills where TOU tariffs apply

  • Scalable retrofits adding storage to existing PV systems

  • Small commercial/edge sites needing clean, quiet storage

Installer tips

  • Use closed-loop profiles over CAN/RS485 where available for safest charging and accurate SOC

  • Size DC cabling and protective devices to current and run length; observe local codes

  • Install indoors in a ventilated, clean, dry space; keep within operating temperature ranges

  • For best life, avoid chronic 100%/0% SOC extremes; follow the recommended charge current

Packed with a robust 5.12kWh of nominal energy, it uses top-tier Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4) chemistry—the safest and most durable battery technology available today. You can expect an incredible 10+ year lifespan with over 6,000 cycles, offering an exceptional return on your solar investment.

Equipped with an intelligent Battery Management System (BMS), the SE-F5-C constantly monitors voltage, current, and temperature to protect against overcharging, discharging, and short circuits. While this standard "C" model focuses on core performance via LED status indicators (rather than an LCD screen), it retains the massive scalability Deye is known for. You can parallel up to 32 units to build a system as large as 163.84kWh, ensuring this battery can grow exactly as your energy needs do.

  • Massive Scalability: Connect up to 32 units in parallel to expand your storage array up to 163.84kWh for demanding off-grid or commercial applications.

  • Broad Compatibility: Features CAN2.0 and RS485 communication ports for plug-and-play integration with Deye hybrid inverters and other major 48V brands.

  • Sleek & Flexible Installation: Supports wall-mounted, floor-mounted, or stack-mounted configurations to perfectly fit your utility room or garage setup.

1. High Cycle Life

  • 6000+ Deep Cycles: The GearUP 12V 100Ah LiFePO4 battery is engineered to deliver over 6000 cycles at 80% Depth of Discharge (DOD), significantly outlasting traditional lead-acid batteries, which typically offer 200-500 cycles. 3. Bluetooth Connectivity

  • Real-Time Monitoring: Bluetooth 5.0 enables users to monitor battery status via a dedicated smartphone app. Parameters such as voltage, charge/discharge current, state of charge (SOC), and protection status can be tracked in real-time, ensuring optimal performance and safety.
